title: A Day at the Park
text:
Sara goes to the park on Sunday. She runs and jumps on the grass. She throws a ball to her dog. Her dog catches it and brings it back.

After that, Sara sits under a big tree. She reads a book and eats an apple. Then she waves to her friend. They walk home together.

questions.text: Where does Sara go on Sunday?
What does Sara eat under the tree?
How does Sara probably feel at the park?
Why does Sara's dog bring the ball back to her?
options: It wants to play with Sara

vocabulary.definition: sends something through the air with the hand
takes hold of something that is moving
looks at words and understands them
moves the hand from side to side to say hello

paragraph_translations: Sara w niedzielę idzie do parku. Biega i skacze po trawie. Rzuca piłkę do swojego psa. Pies ją łapie i przynosi z powrotem.
Potem Sara siada pod dużym drzewem. Czyta książkę i je jabłko. Następnie macha do swojej koleżanki. Razem wracają do domu.
